items.sentence: The store clerk handed me a receipt for two bread loaves.
This dark chocolate tastes bitter, not sweet at all.
A new haircut changed the appearance of our friendly neighbor.
Heat moves from the hot iron into the shirt, flattening wrinkles.
Warm rice sits in my palm before I shape it.
The dining table looks fancy with lace cloth and gold plates.
Before washing, we soak the dirty socks in soapy water.
Soft cotton pajamas appeal to shoppers who want comfortable sleep.
We compare two winter coats by warmth and name one difference.
Heavy rain can compel us to eat lunch inside today.
